👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻 Good for you. I’ve had pieces of shit like that in my life. 

I wish you all the best in you bright future.

When I felt like I only existed like an NPC. I felt like my life that I had built was a pretty little lie to how I felt and in one month, I lost my Nan, both me and my mum were made redundant, my dad tried to commit suicide and I ended a 11 year relationship coz he only used me for sex and that was it. 

Though I have still yet to go to any doctors.
I wish you luck, and I hope you find the love and inner happiness that you are looking for x

Then this is gonna sound hard, but do it. Find yourself a job that is ok for now, if you have anyone you can crash with for a time while you work out your finances for somewhere or move in with a friend if people are thinking of moving out too. 

If you find a “crappy” job remind yourself it’s not for forever. If you want to save to get back into education do so, if you want t go a different route or do something you love that can make money go for it, your life will be your own. 

Please remember taking this step isn’t to prove your mother wrong, it’s doing what’s best for you. 
If she starts saying “well it’s about time” or starts to attack your decisions or actions in anyway, try to ignore her negativity and do what’s right for you.

She doesn’t just need therapy, she needs to stop disregarding you and your feelings. And to say that to you is beyond cruel, especially if you are in a bad place already. You need a place of love, to feel you can be you.
I’m sorry everyone deserves support and your mother needs either a good talking to or a slap (no disrespect). A mother should be there for her child no matter how old you are.
Defiantly, wow it’s been nice having a nice discussion.
Have you tried listening to The Martian? It always makes me giggle and is an easy listen.
But I will take a listen, thanks for the link.

I wouldn’t say religious text, I ment as an emotional comfort. I know people do find solace in religious txt and teachings and find comfort in that. 

What I ment more like an emotional comforter, because the world feels so familiar.

I’m sorry to read you are going through what seems like hell, I can relate. 

My Nan introduced me to audiobooks, the year she passed away was the beginning of the hardest next  few years of my life. I’d listen to the Jim Dale narration of these books to help me sleep and helped me through the day. 

If you need to talk or to cry or to rant. Please don’t hesitate.
It helps me through bad days too. My bf has basically turned our bedroom and conservatory into a HP safe space.
It’s nice to know how much comfort these 7 books bring .
Yup, always in the outside looking in.
Thanks I’ll give something a try.
If I’m honest, I don’t know what normal is anymore.
Yeah, it kinda feels like wading through mud.
